discovery_caveats: Metadata advertises server capabilities, not this client entitlement.
Both observed grant_types_supported arrays omit client_credentials even though product docs support it.
Both observed scope arrays omit allOrder.read, invoice.read and invoice.history.read; production additionally advertises allInvoice.read.
Do not substitute allInvoice.read for the documented invoice scopes, enable password/implicit grants, or enable provider-management scopes from discovery.
